mathematical_contract.tempered_target: pi_beta(x) proportional to product_i p_i(x_i) times L(x)^beta; priors and retained supports stay unchanged; beta=1 is the original target and beta=0 the independent prior.
mathematical_contract.site_update: Exact heat-bath p_i(s)*exp(beta*logL(x_-i,s)); each site kernel satisfies detailed balance. Systematic scan is a composition of invariant kernels, not claimed reversible.
mathematical_contract.whole_replica_swap: For fixed adjacent beta_a,beta_b and complete states x_a,x_b, accept min(1,exp((beta_a-beta_b)*(logL(x_b)-logL(x_a)))). Fixed symmetric swap proposal satisfies detailed balance for the product of tempered targets.
mathematical_contract.coordinated_block_swap: Swap the same fixed peer-coordinate subset between replicas, never arbitrary taxi values across different peers. Independent identical priors across temperatures cancel; acceptance log ratio is beta_a*(logL(x_a_new)-logL(x_a))+beta_b*(logL(x_b_new)-logL(x_b)). The simplified whole-replica ratio is invalid for partial swaps.
mathematical_contract.proof_if_authorized: Enumerate two/three-peer finite supports and two replicas; verify every site/swap kernel detailed balance and full-sweep stationarity to numerical tolerance, then cold marginal and Rao-Blackwell mean against exact enumeration. Check beta0, identical-temperature swaps and support validity.
mathematical_contract.estimator: Use only beta1 cold states; compute original beta1 target conditional/Rao-Blackwell summary after all swaps. Hot samples are not posterior samples. Keep joint/dep views separate.

cost_and_precision.cost_caveat: Unmeasured extrapolation from the retained C sampler; a fresh bounded pilot would need authorization and a fixed timeout. Full replica sweeps cost approximately linearly in temperature count; exact two-peer heat-bath blocks add support-product cost.
cost_and_precision.precision_caveat: The SD comes from a nonconverged trace, so this is an illustrative capacity calculation, not an established posterior variance or rigorous lower bound. Better mixing alone does not guarantee accurate posterior means.
cost_and_precision.workspace_plan_if_authorized: Generate uniforms sequentially by independent ladder, retain cold summaries/replica identities only, and share immutable support arrays; an eight-temperature version of the old budget fits below256MiB incremental memory.

strongest_objections: Tempering broadens away from a narrow feasible aggregate shell. Low overlap between temperatures may prevent cold/hot round trips; adding temperatures increases runtime.
Compensating within-shell allocations can stay difficult even when aggregate totals and log likelihood mix. Target/copy modes must be monitored separately.
Whole-state swaps reassign existing configurations; they do not create compensated moves. Fixed coordinated blocks may help but can miss relevant peer combinations.

Even exact numerical integration would retain potentially misspecified priors/source noise and local-cohort factorization. It contributes no new information and the prior exact largest-peer screen was near-flat.
bounded_test_if_later_authorized: Reuse the frozen7/69/475-peer cohorts, four overdispersed ladders, original two burn/sweep budgets and original scopes. Predeclare one temperature ladder/swap schedule; monitor cold target/copy/aggregate Rhat and both bulk/mean ESS, cross-budget means/MCSE, edge swap rates and replica round trips. Report all cohorts and stop at one fixed runtime budget; no ladder search, easier-cohort gate, held labels, CV or production.

score_scale_distinction: A10-second per-flight Monte Carlo tolerance is an illustration, not a required scientific acceptance threshold. It can be stricter than needed for a useful whole-score increment, especially for sparse affected rows. Any future design would need a prediction-vector/score-scale Monte Carlo error bound, affected-row coverage and independent-chain stability, rather than cold ESS or one-flight MCSE alone. Current poor mixing and nonconverged variance estimates are inadequate; no scoring or new data scan was performed to infer such a bound.
